What We DO

Research

Materials and Devices

People

Meet the researchers behind Turin Electronics.

MF

Principal Investigator

Marco Fanciulli

I am a Full Professor of Condensed Matter Physics at the University of Turin. My research focuses on nanoelectronics, spintronics, neuroelectronics, and unconventional computing devices.

FU

Tenure-Track Researcher

Francesca Urban

I am a tenure-track researcher in Experimental Condensed Matter Physics at the University of Turin. My research focuses on two-dimensional materials, nanoelectronic devices, and unconventional computing.
